---
name: Feature request
about: A new capability or an enhancement to an existing one.
labels: enhancement
---

**Problem**
<!-- what are you trying to do that impopk does not let you do today? -->

**Proposed change**
<!-- the smallest interface change that would solve it: a new CLI flag,
a new output column, a new library function, etc. -->

**Alternatives considered**
<!-- workarounds you tried, or alternative designs and why you prefer
this one. -->

**Scope**
<!-- which crate(s) would change: ibs, ibd, ancestry, jacquard,
argraph, or the workspace. -->
